column1: # Tag audit proposals — tranche 4: every 8th flag by code at offset 3 (32 of 254).
# Additions and aliases; removals are their own round. See #174.
# HOW TO REVIEW: delete the rows you disagree with. What survives is applied.
# Nothing else to fill in; the deletions are themselves the record of your call.
# The pull request shows each flag's image beside its row.
# Then say so, and the agent runs scripts/apply-tag-audit.mjs, the validators and
# the Playwright suite. Do not edit proposals.original.tsv — the difference
# between it and this file is how your rejections get remembered.
# Read the name; the code beside it is what the script applies to, and a row whose
# name and code disagree is refused. To see a flag: https://flagfilter.com/?q=<name>
# Columns: name, code, tag or alias, add|remove|alias, confidence, why.

column6: The V holds three horizontal bands, black, blue and white, and they are most of the design.
A yellow, black and white cross spans the flag, as its own symbolism says.
The silk-cotton tree stands on a grey shield under the six stars.
Erin, with her cross and harp, stands on a shield.
The armillary sphere is gold, and it is the largest emblem on the flag.
Triglav and the stars are on a blue shield with a red border.
Two wavy lines run under Triglav; the flag's own symbolism calls them the Adriatic and the rivers.
The quartered arms are on a shield between the two pillars.
The emblem is a sisserou parrot, as the flag's own symbolism says.
The emblem is a triskelion, as the flag's own symbolism says.
